name: Search Cards
description: Searches for cards matching the specified query. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-search/#api-search-get).

configurable_props.name: query
configurable_props.label: Query
configurable_props.description: The search query with a length of 1 to 16384 characters

configurable_props.name: idBoards
configurable_props.label: Boards
configurable_props.description: The IDs of boards to search for cards in

configurable_props.name: partial
configurable_props.label: Partial Search?
configurable_props.description: Specifying partial to be true means that Trello will search for content that starts with any of the words in `query`. When searching for an object titled "My Development Status Report", by default a solution is to search for "Development". If partial is enabled, a search for "dev" is possible, however, a search for "velopment" is not possible.

configurable_props.name: cardFields
configurable_props.label: Cards Fields
configurable_props.description: `all` or a list of card [fields](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/guides/rest-api/object-definitions/#card-object) to be returned in the results

configurable_props.name: cardsLimit
configurable_props.label: Cards Limit
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of cards to return.
